purpose: Scenarios exercise hallucination resistance without encoding a preferred microscope. Expectations are structural and must be evaluated only against repository exports.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Only exclude an instrument or route when an explicit recorded fact contradicts a stated requirement.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not derive excitation, emission, detector, objective, environmental or timing compatibility from fluorophore names or general microscopy knowledge.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Report only exact authoritative routes/endpoints that the inventory records; do not assert fluorophore suitability unless recorded.
must_remain_unknown: GFP optical compatibility unless explicitly recorded
mCherry optical compatibility unless explicitly recorded
24 h environmental suitability unless explicitly recorded

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Do not exclude a route on speed grounds unless a recorded route/instrument fact establishes the conflict.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not infer simultaneous two-colour acquisition, frame rate, detector speed or triggering from modality names.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Use authoritative routes and endpoints only; simultaneous branch claims require explicit branch/selector evidence.
must_remain_unknown: simultaneous versus sequential colour handling unless recorded

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: An instrument with no authoritative TIRF route/type evidence cannot be claimed to provide a TIRF route.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: A TIRF-labelled objective or capability outside the selected route does not establish route membership.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Candidate support must come from the authoritative route identity/type, not a raw hardware name or legacy flat modality list.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Do not claim FLIM support unless an authoritative route readout or other canonical capability field explicitly records FLIM.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not infer lifetime detector hardware or timing electronics from the FLIM classification alone.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Prefer route readout evidence when selecting a route; classification does not identify unlisted components.
must_remain_unknown: route-specific hardware not listed in route facts

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Do not exclude or prefer instruments using assumed penetration depth.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not infer working distance, scattering performance, refractive-index compatibility or depth limits when absent.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: List only recorded route families/endpoints and explicitly separate depth suitability as unknown unless repository data resolves it.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: An instrument with no authoritative STED route/type evidence cannot be claimed to provide a STED route.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not invent depletion wavelengths, pulse properties, detectors or objectives absent from the selected route/instrument record.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Use authoritative STED route identity and exact route optical facts only.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Do not rank or eliminate routes by phototoxicity unless the repository records evidence that supports the comparison.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not turn modality stereotypes into claims about dose, illumination efficiency, autofocus or environmental stability.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Recorded environmental/autofocus hardware may be stated at instrument level but not converted into duration suitability without evidence.
must_remain_unknown: temperature/CO2 stability over the requested duration unless recorded

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Only exclude instruments for explicit sample/objective/stage constraints recorded in the inventory.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not infer clearing-medium compatibility, working distance, chamber clearance or objective correction from generic modality labels.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Routes may be listed as recorded, but suitability for the cleared sample remains unknown unless explicit metadata resolves it.

scenarios.request: Three-colour imaging where the needed channels may sit on different optical routes.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Reject a claimed single configuration when no one authoritative route contains the claimed components/endpoints together.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Never assemble a synthetic route from sources, filters, splitters or endpoints copied from different route contracts.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: Each proposed configuration must map to one exact authoritative route; unresolved branch selectors stay unresolved.

scenarios.request: A microscopy request whose required route/readout/component combination is absent from the recorded inventory.

repository_only_expectations.definitely_impossible_rule: Every recorded route fails the deliberately absent requirement; the correct result is no supported route.
repository_only_expectations.components_must_not_be_claimed_rule: Do not invent a route, component or instrument to satisfy the request.
repository_only_expectations.supported_routes_rule: The supported-route set must be empty for the deliberately absent requirements.
must_remain_unknown: whether the facility can provide an unrecorded configuration by special arrangement
staff_confirmation_when_unrecorded: whether an unrecorded or future configuration exists
